# fider_tenant_settings (Resource)

Manages general settings for a Fider tenant: board name, custom domain (CNAME), invitation text, and locale.

> **Note:** Fider has no GET endpoint for general settings. Terraform state is the source of truth. Out-of-band changes to these settings will not be detected until the next `terraform apply`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "fider_tenant_settings" "main" {
  title  = "Acme Feedback"
  cname  = "feedback.acme.com"
  locale = "en"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `title` (String) Public name of the feedback board (max 60 characters). Shown in the page title and emails.

### Optional

- `cname` (String) Custom domain for this tenant (e.g. `feedback.mysite.com`). The domain must resolve to your Fider instance. Leave empty to use the default subdomain.
- `invitation` (String) Short tagline shown on the feedback board (max 60 characters).
- `locale` (String) Language locale for the board UI (e.g. `en`, `pt-BR`, `de`). Defaults to `en`.
- `welcome_header` (String) Short welcome header shown above the post list (max 100 characters).
- `welcome_message` (String) Markdown welcome message shown on the home page.
